## Ornithology Week 1 Practice Problems: Diversity and Taxonomy  

1) Endothermy is an apomorphy for modern birds (**T** or **F**)  

2) Which of the following are avian apomorphies? (You may select multiple answers.)
   a) feathers
   b) furcula
   c) uncinate processes
   d) the larynx
   e) the gizzard

3) Select the answer that correctly describes hierarchical taxonomic relationships (i.e., the taxon on the left encompasses the taxon immediately to its right, and so on).
   a) Neognathae > Neoaves > Telluraves 
   b) Neognathae > Neoaves > Telluraves 
   c) Telluraves > Neoaves > Sphenisciformes
   d) Paleognathae > Neognathae > Aequornithes

4) Consider the evolutionary trees (*phylogenies*) below (from Gregory 2008, *Evolution: Education and Outreach*): 

    - Do they show the same set of relationships? (Y / N)
    - In tree **a**, is the frog more closely related to the fish or the lizard? (Fish / Lizard)
